data.title: Strategy
data.lede: The planning work that decides what the site is for, who it serves, and how it earns its keep.
data.body: Strategy always comes first. Without it, design becomes decoration. We start with a working session, then I write a short brief that the rest of the project follows.

points.text: A working session, then back-and-forth until the plan is right
Content inventory of what you already have
A one-page brief the rest of the project follows

data.title: Web design
data.lede: Modern, accessible, fast websites built on the platform that fits you, from a custom-coded site to Squarespace or WordPress, and set up so your team can actually run it.
data.body: I match the build to your budget and to whoever will maintain it after launch. Everything is built mobile-first and tested for accessibility from the very first screen, then handed off so you are never locked out of your own site.

points.text: A custom design built to your brand, not a stock template
Deployed to Cloudflare Pages, auto-rebuild on every commit

data.title: Photography
data.lede: Headshots, event coverage, and environmental photography shot for your website by the same person who designed it.
data.body: When the photographer and the designer are one person, the photos match the layout instead of fighting it. Images arrive edited, web-optimized, and ready to drop in.

points.text: Edited, web-optimized images delivered with the website
